references.text: Jacob also asked the name of the one he wrestled with at Jabbok and received a similarly evasive answer
Moses asked God for his name at the burning bush, showing a similar desire to know God's identity
Gideon also asked for a sign from the angel of the Lord and wished to honor him, a parallel situation to Manoah's encounter
The angel's answer to Manoah that his name is "Wonderful", which connects directly to this question
The Messiah is called "Wonderful" in Isaiah's prophecy, which can be linked to the angel's description of his name as wonderful
